title: feat(auth): AI service accounts, O3 of ADR-0151 — a sys_user of kind agent with an accountable owner, no sign-in, its own keys and the agent ceiling
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Filing gate: **④ coordination — the open-code child of an accepted ADR.** ADR-0151 (`docs/adr/0151-ai-service-account-a-headless-agent-is-a-registered-principal-of-its-own.md`, card #31603, merged with PR #31615 as `cae8d8fe` on 2026-11-09) names this item **O3** under "What builds on this". The `repo:cloud#3` stand-down brief (#30278 comment 6727651596, item 3) owed filing it after that merge; the maintainer's word on placement, recorded there verbatim: 「objectstack 卡不用你派发，放到车道就行」 — so this card goes to triage for its lane, and the cloud seat does not dispatch it.

## What O3 is (ADR-0151, quoted scope)

The account itself, D1–D4 and D6:
- D1: `sys_user.principal_kind` (`human` default | `agent`), born with its kind and immutable for every caller; `sys_user.accountable_user_id` (required on `agent`, a human member of the same org); one plain `sys_member` row; placeholder `.invalid` address; registration only by an org administrator or a platform administrator.
- D2: `sessionBefore` refuses a session for an `agent` row (every sign-in method, impersonation, admin-minted sessions); the account-create hook refuses a `sys_account` row for it.
- D3: the `everyone` anchor skip in `resolveUserAuthzGrants` (as for an external member); the ceiling clamp at evaluation (no View/Modify All, destructive class, system permission, wildcard, admin scope, `isSystem`); the refusal by name when a ceiling-breaching set is assigned; rewrite `agent-ceiling-grant-refusal.ts`'s premise sentence in the same change.
- D4/D6: the registration, key-mint (owner or admin, signed in), suspend (= ban), resume (admin only), change-owner, owner-leaves auto-suspend and retire doors; key admission carries `principal_kind` on the owner read it already makes (`USER_BAN_FIELDS` gains the column), and the shared assembler stamps `principalKind: 'agent'` with no `onBehalfOf`.
- The inventory of code that reads `principalKind === 'agent'` as OAuth-shaped (`action-execution.ts`, `automation.ts#connectorConnectionDelegatedCaller`, `explain-engine.ts`, storage and comment access hooks), each given an account answer.

## Pins O3 owes (ADR-0151, verbatim list)
An account's key on REST, on `/mcp` and over stdio each admits `principalKind: 'agent'`, with `userId` the account and no `onBehalfOf`; every sign-in method and impersonation refuse an account; a ceiling-breaching set assigned to an account and then edited grants nothing; a suspended account's key is refused on its next call and works again after resume.

## Who reads this
Lane: triage routes it (the touched packages — `platform-objects`, `plugin-auth`, `core`, `plugin-security` — read as `domain:server`; `domain:*` is triage's to set). Downstream: cloud#3886 (counting, ADR-0116 D7) is Blocked-by this card; cloud#3820's console consumes the identity. Business reason: the maintainer's D7 rule (cloud#3844) — each agent's service identity is one AI user — cannot be metered until an agent identity exists; today an agent on a person's key is invisible to counting, listing and stopping.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "AI service account"` → 6 hits, 5 closed (#31603 the ADR, #31606, #31605, #31029, #23158) and #12708 (a seat post); `"service account" principal_kind` → 1 (#31603). No implementation card exists.
